social_workflow.trigger: Local verify_published_release.py after exact successful deployment and public verification
social_workflow.publication_method: Manual browser interaction in Chrome Bike, correct profile/company tabs; never Grok

scope: Local editorial preparation only; production files and workflow remain untouched

article.outbound_evidence_links: Separate HR/DE/EN local source dossiers, pending owner's preference for any future change
article.analysis_format: Concrete analytical bullets with bold opening statement, then a short synthesis
article.footer: Localized follow-Metaadvisor call to action, informative disclaimer and AI collaboration notice

educational_context.reader: Do not assume familiarity with companies or technical terminology
company_context: verified origin and founders when relevant
concrete impact on users or markets
educational_context.integration: Natural explanatory journalism, not encyclopedic introductions
educational_context.unknowns: Explicitly distinguish undisclosed details from established facts

front_matter.format: Quoted strings, compact tag arrays, explicit image_alt; preserve category/categories and four matching image fields
front_matter.tags: Only existing approved terms; do not copy unapproved tags from examples or create archives

social_crop_safe_composition.headline: Short English headline, large and legible, near center; never put essential text at top edge
social_crop_safe_composition.main_subject: Keep recognizable identity and key motif within the central horizontal band
social_crop_safe_composition.watermark: Keep existing discreet MetaAdvisor.eu watermark; never duplicate it

punctuation_policy.scope: All HR/DE/EN editorial text, titles, headings, analysis, social posts and image descriptions

image_alt_policy.language: Match HR, DE or EN article language
image_alt_policy.style: One short sentence or headline description of the main subject
image_alt_policy.omit: Colours, backgrounds, layout, watermark and decorative production details
image_alt_policy.data_charts: State what is plotted and the period; do not repeat every value
image_alt_policy.review: Human review for topic relevance, language and brevity; mechanical validation is supplementary

publication_file_layout.date_source: Existing article front matter date, preserve its calendar publication date
publication_file_layout.public_URLs: Preserve language prefix, slug and existing Hugo permalinks
publication_file_layout.published_files: No automatic relocation or editing; prepare a separate exact-byte move plan for review
